name: get_pod_status
description: Retrieve current status, phase, container states, ready conditions, and restart counts for a Kubernetes Pod.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the target pod.

pod.description: The name of the target pod.

name: get_pod_events
description: Retrieve chronological Kubernetes Events associated with a specific Pod to inspect scheduling, image pulling, and lifecycle errors.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the target pod.

pod.description: The name of the target pod.

name: get_container_logs
description: Retrieve recent log output lines from a specific container running inside a Kubernetes Pod.

container.description: The name of the container within the pod.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the target pod.

pod.description: The name of the target pod.

tail_lines.description: Maximum number of recent log lines to retrieve (default: 100).

name: get_node_status
description: Retrieve node capacity, allocatable CPU and memory resources, conditions, and system metadata for a cluster node.

node_name.description: The name of the target node.

name: get_gpu_status
description: Retrieve extended GPU resource capacity, allocatable quantities, and GPU model details for a cluster node.

node_name.description: The name of the target node.

name: get_service_status
description: Retrieve Kubernetes Service metadata, ClusterIP, exposed ports, endpoint addresses, and selector matching status for a workload or service.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the service or pod.

pod.description: The target pod name to evaluate against matching service selectors.

service_name.description: The name of the target Kubernetes service.

name: get_storage_status
description: Retrieve PVC phase, bound PV details, capacity, volume mode, and StorageClass binding configuration for pod storage volumes.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the target pod or PVC.

pod.description: The target pod referencing persistent volume claims.

name: get_workload_status
description: Retrieve controller ownership chain, desired vs ready replicas, rollout strategy, and controller conditions for a workload.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the workload.

pod.description: The target pod name whose managing controller is being inspected.

workload_kind.description: The workload controller kind (e.g. Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Job).

workload_name.description: The name of the target workload controller.

name: get_configuration_status
description: Retrieve configuration reference status for ConfigMaps, Secret key metadata (zero raw secrets), ServiceAccounts, and image pull secrets.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace of the target pod.

pod.description: The target pod referencing ConfigMaps, Secrets, or ServiceAccounts.
